name: Gourmet Egypt.com Foods S.A.E.
source: stockanalysis.com (secondary data provider, figures as reported by that provider, not read from the exchange filing)
note: Figures in the unit shown, converted from the provider's millions EGP. Each fiscal year header cell was matched to its own data cell, so the provider trailing twelve month column is excluded. Every printed identity ties: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, and profit before tax less income tax equals net profit.
reconciliation_note: Net Change in Cash as printed by the source does not equal Operating + Investing + Financing in FY2024 (printed 10950000.0 vs 10680000.0). Both figures are as filed and are shown unchanged.
